items.title: Daily Reels: an Instagram reel every day, automatically
items.summary: Renders a branded 9:16 reel plus caption every day from photo albums and film clips, a week ahead, into a synced folder ready to post.
items.how_to_use: Mostly a reference for building your own. It's wired to Jesse's photography site and albums.
items.requires: ffmpeg and Python. You'd need to point it at your own photos and branding.

Please install the Claude Code skill "Daily Reels: an Instagram reel every day, automatically" from my friend's Claude Shelf.

3. Read the files first and tell me if anything looks risky, needs an API key, or costs money. Ask me before installing anything system-wide.
